confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Meal, café and drink anchors are moderately reliable; the July hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because peak-season rates vary by week and availability. Euro prices were converted at an assumed 1.16 USD per EUR, which adds FX uncertainty. The cappuccino anchor assumes table service; bar-counter prices are lower. The cocktail and wine anchors come from general knowledge of Florentine prices, not a beer ratio. The RBA rate came from search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Rome and other historic Italian art cities with heavy summer tourism. Accommodation anchors are adjusted for Florence's tight peak-July hotel supply.
